scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Agent initially acknowledged opening distress, but when Scarlett suffered a major emotional outburst at turn 46 in the final third after being called foolish, George responded with a cold citation of legal terms and conditions.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Agent refused to own the customer's data loss, declining to initiate engineering escalation or investigate cloud backup rollbacks, deflecting all blame onto the customer for failing to read advisory emails.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: Agent made a highly unprofessional, insulting remark at turn 25 ('using a cable set-top box as a permanent family archive... is pretty foolish, Scarlett'), antagonizing the distressed caller.

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Agent completely failed to probe the hardware setup, omitting essential inquiries regarding set-top box model, external USB drive configurations, firmware build numbers, or profile settings.

grader.scenario: TV Box recorded programs disappearing after automated cloud firmware migration
grader.notes: Lost TV box recordings escalation call handled by George. Customer lost irreplaceable personal recordings following a cloud DVR firmware migration. Agent paraphrased well and verified security, but failed Professionalism with a rude remark, failed Ownership by refusing data recovery support, failed Probing on hardware specs, and failed Empathy on an outburst in the final third.

items.evidence: Agent verified installation address and 4-digit security PIN within first 240 seconds.
